node.title: M720 calibration certificate semantics
node.statement: For M720 MITM outputs, a zero active-core count is a complete calibration-cell zero certificate only when the run has complete=true, equivalently W=n and the run did not abort. If complete=false, the output is slice-local evidence only and cannot be promoted to a global zero certificate.
node.attack_surface: formal consequence of the mitm_slice complete flag and enumerator contract
node.falsifier: a certificate protocol that treats W<n or aborted output as a complete global zero
